segments.ja303:1.1: Anuttare kāmaguṇe samiddhe, bhutvāna pubbe vasī ekarāja;
segments.ja303:1.3: So dāni dugge narakamhi khitto, nappajjahe vaṇṇabalaṃ purāṇaṃ.
segments.ja303:2.1: Pubbeva khantī ca tapo ca mayhaṃ, sampatthitā dubbhisena [dabbasenā (sī. pī.)] ahosi;
segments.ja303:2.3: Taṃ dāni laddhāna kathaṃ nu rāja, jahe ahaṃ vaṇṇabalaṃ purāṇaṃ.
segments.ja303:3.1: Sabbā kirevaṃ pariniṭṭhitāni, yasassinaṃ paññavantaṃ visayha;
segments.ja303:3.3: Yaso ca laddhā purimaṃ uḷāraṃ, nappajjahe vaṇṇabalaṃ purāṇaṃ.
segments.ja303:4.1: Panujja dukkhena sukhaṃ janinda, sukhena vā dukkhamasayhasāhi;
segments.ja303:4.3: Ubhayattha santo abhinibbutattā, sukhe ca dukkhe ca bhavanti tulyāti.

lines: Nappajjahe vaṇṇabalaṃ purāṇanti evarūpe visamaṭṭhāne khittopi porāṇakavaṇṇañca balañca nappajahasīti pucchati.
“Pubbeva khantī ca tapo ca mayhaṃ, sampatthitā dubbhisena ahosi;
Taṃdāni laddhāna kathaṃ nu rāja, jahe ahaṃ vaṇṇabalaṃ purāṇaṃ.
Yaso ca laddhā purimaṃ uḷāraṃ, nappajjahe vaṇṇabalaṃ purāṇaṃ.
“Panujja dukkhena sukhaṃ janinda, sukhena vā dukkhamasayhasāhi;
Ubhayattha santo abhinibbutattā, sukhe ca dukkhe ca bhavanti tulyā”ti.
Yassa hi dukkhaṃ vā domanassaṃ vā hoti, so taṃ jaheyyāti dīpeti.
“Sabbā kirevaṃ pariniṭṭhitānī”ti anussavavasena attano sampattiṃ dassento āha.
Idaṃ vuttaṃ hoti – sabbāneva mama kattabbakiccāni dānasīlabhāvanāuposathakammāni pubbeva niṭṭhitānīti.
Yasassinaṃ paññavantaṃ visayhāti parivārasampattiyā yasassi, paññāsampadāya paññavanta, asayhasāhitāya visayha.
Nappajjaheti evarūpaṃ yasaṃ laddhā kiṃkāraṇā purāṇavaṇṇabalaṃ jahissāmīti attho.
Dukkhenāti tayā uppāditena narakamhi khipanadukkhena mama rajjasukhaṃ panuditvā.
Sukhena vā dukkhanti jhānasukhena vā taṃ dukkhaṃ panuditvā.
Ubhayattha santoti ye santo honti mādisā, te dvīsupi etesu koṭṭhāsesu abhinibbutasabhāvā majjhattā sukhe ca dukkhe ca bhavanti tulyā, ekasadisā nibbikārāva hontīti.
